content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy, a popular platform for digital products, provides a user-friendly experience for creators in supported countries. However, it lacks availability in many regions, including parts of Africa and South Asia. This exclusion pushes creators to seek alternatives that not only allow them to sell products but also enable reliable payment processing. Alternatives like Gumroad and PayPal may offer similar features but also restrict their services in many countries, causing further frustration. In contrast, COREMERCH's solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack leverage decentralized infrastructure to ensure that creators have access to robust digital commerce tools regardless of their location.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal impose strict geographical restrictions, often preventing users in countries like Nigeria and Ghana from accessing their services. A PayPal account suspension can freeze funds for up to 180 days without recourse, leaving creators vulnerable. Lemon Squeezy similarly lacks support for many regions. COREMERCH addresses these limitations head-on by providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure that operates independently of geographical restrictions, allowing creators to fully own their online businesses and operate without fear of sudden service interruptions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When evaluating payment options, speed and fees are critical considerations. Platforms like Stripe may offer quick transactions, but the hidden costs of account restrictions and international fees can outweigh these benefits. PayPal's fee structure is also complicated, especially when accounting for currency conversion and withdrawal fees. In contrast, COREMERCH utilizes NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a straightforward 0.5% fee. Transaction costs on recommended networks like BSC and Solana are typically under $0.10, making it a cost-effective solution for creators in restricted countries.
Own your digital commerce stack, not just rent it.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most appealing aspects of sovereign commerce infrastructure is ownership. Unlike traditional platforms, which retain control over user data and transactions, COREMERCH solutions provide creators with full data ownership post-deployment. This allows for automated order processing and delivery without reliance on third-party services. With systems designed for seamless integration and instant product delivery, creators can maintain [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-2|COREMERCH guide to complete]]-deep-dive-cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks|The Complete]] control over their digital products, ensuring they are not at the mercy of platform policies.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on individual needs. For those requiring a quick setup with essential functionalities, the Sovereign Starter Stack is an excellent option, while the Edge Commerce Stack provides a more comprehensive solution with advanced features. This latter option is ideal for creators looking to scale their business quickly and requires deployment within 48 hours, complete with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations. By evaluating specific needs and choosing the right stack, creators can build a resilient online store that operates without the constraints of traditional payment platforms.

If Stripe isn't available in your country, COREMERCH provides a robust alternative. By using the Edge Commerce Stack, you can create a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. This infrastructure eliminates the dependency on restricted platforms, empowering you to sell digital products effectively.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
